title: Define Poem data type
description: Create a dataclass or NamedTuple named Poem with three fields: author (str), title (str), body (str). Export from poem/core.py. All fields are required and non-empty.
done_when: Poem type is defined and importable. TEST-003 can construct and verify Poem objects.

title: Define DisplayConfig data type
description: Create a dataclass or NamedTuple named DisplayConfig with three fields: title_format (str), author_format (str), body_format (str). Export from poem/config.py. Default values: title_format='Title: {title}', author_format='Author: {author}', body_format='{body}'.
done_when: DisplayConfig type is defined with correct defaults. TEST-017 verifies default values match exactly.

title: Define error types (FetchError, ConfigError, NoCachedPoemError)
description: Create three exception classes: FetchError (for API failures), ConfigError (for config parse failures), NoCachedPoemError (for empty cache). Each takes a message parameter. Export from poem/errors.py.
done_when: All three error types are defined and can be raised/caught. Tests TEST-005, TEST-006, TEST-012, TEST-018, TEST-028 can distinguish between them.

title: Create project structure and pyproject.toml
description: Set up Python project structure at /Users/tonalli/dev/ollin/calmecac/poem/. Create directories: poem/, tests/. Create pyproject.toml at /Users/tonalli/dev/ollin/calmecac/poem/pyproject.toml with name='poem', entry_points={'console_scripts': {'poem': 'poem.cli:main'}}, and dependencies: requests, pyyaml. Assume Python 3.9+. Use uv to initialize the project.
done_when: pyproject.toml exists with correct entry point. 'poem' command can be invoked (even if not fully implemented yet).

title: Implement API Fetcher with timeout and error handling
description: Create poem/api_fetcher.py with a fetch() function that makes an HTTP GET request to the poetry API (TBD: PoetryDB or other confirmed API). Set timeout to 5 seconds. Parse JSON response and extract author, title, body. Validate that author and title are present (non-empty strings). Raise FetchError on: timeout, connection error, invalid JSON, missing fields.
done_when: fetch() function returns Poem or raises FetchError. TEST-003, TEST-004, TEST-005, TEST-006 all pass.

title: Create cache directory structure handler
description: Create poem/cache.py with a helper function ensure_cache_dir() that creates ~/.cache/poem/ directory if it doesn't exist. Respect $XDG_CACHE_HOME if set. Use os.makedirs() with exist_ok=True. Handle permission errors gracefully by logging to stderr.
done_when: ensure_cache_dir() can be called and creates the directory. Directory respects XDG_CACHE_HOME. TEST-013 passes.

title: Implement cache save with atomic writes
description: Create Cache Manager class in poem/cache.py with save(poem: Poem) method. Write poem to JSON format with schema {author, title, body, timestamp (ISO8601)}. Use atomic write: write to ~/.cache/poem/poem_cache.tmp, then rename to ~/.cache/poem/poem_cache.json. Log failures to stderr but don't raise exceptions.
done_when: save(poem) creates/overwrites poem_cache.json with correct schema. TEST-007, TEST-008, TEST-009, TEST-010 all pass.

title: Implement cache load
description: Add load_cached() method to Cache Manager class. Read ~/.cache/poem/poem_cache.json, parse JSON, return Poem object. If file doesn't exist or is empty, raise NoCachedPoemError with descriptive message. Respect $XDG_CACHE_HOME if set.
done_when: load_cached() returns Poem when cache exists, raises NoCachedPoemError when empty. TEST-011, TEST-012 pass.

title: Implement Config Loader with defaults and fallback
description: Create poem/config.py with load_config() function. Try to read ~/.config/poem/display.yaml. If file exists and is valid YAML, parse and return DisplayConfig. If file missing or unreadable, return default DisplayConfig with hardcoded values. If YAML parse fails, raise ConfigError. Respect $XDG_CONFIG_HOME if set.
done_when: load_config() returns DisplayConfig from file or defaults. TEST-015, TEST-016, TEST-017, TEST-019, TEST-020 all pass. TEST-018 verifies ConfigError on parse failure.

title: Implement Display Engine with template substitution
description: Create poem/display.py with render(poem: Poem, config: DisplayConfig, status_message: str = None) function. Substitute {title}, {author}, {body} placeholders in config format strings. Always render author and title (even if config omits them; use defaults). Print to stdout. If status_message provided, print to stderr first. Use plain text (no ANSI colors).
done_when: render() produces correctly formatted output. TEST-021, TEST-022, TEST-023, TEST-024, TEST-039 pass.

title: Implement Error Handler decision tree
description: Create poem/error_handler.py with handle_error(exception, context) function. Implement decision tree: On FetchError, attempt cache load; if cache has poem, return (action='show_poem', poem, status_message='⚠️ Could not fetch live poem. Showing cached poem.', exit_code=0); if cache empty, return (action='show_error', poem=None, status_message='⚠️ Could not fetch poem. No cached poem available. Please check your internet connection and try again.', exit_code=1). On ConfigError, return (action='use_defaults', status_message='⚠️ Configuration error. Using default display format.', exit_code=0). On other exceptions, return (action='show_error', status_message='An unexpected error occurred. Please report this.', exit_code=1).
done_when: handle_error() implements full decision tree. TEST-025, TEST-026, TEST-027, TEST-028, TEST-029, TEST-030, TEST-031, TEST-032, TEST-033, TEST-034 all pass.

title: Implement CLI Entry Point with top-level exception handling
description: Create poem/cli.py with main() function as console script entry point. Accept no arguments (reject any args/flags with error message and exit code 1). Wrap entire pipeline in try-except: call API Fetcher fetch(), on success call Cache Manager save(), call Config Loader load_config(), call Display Engine render(), exit 0. On any exception, call Error Handler handle_error() and execute its decision.
done_when: main() function orchestrates pipeline correctly. TEST-001, TEST-002, TEST-035, TEST-036, TEST-037, TEST-038, TEST-040 pass.

title: Verify successful end-to-end fetch and display
description: Run full pipeline with network connectivity and valid config. Verify: poem is fetched, cached, and displayed correctly with exit code 0. No status messages. Author and title are present in output.
done_when: TEST-038 passes (successful fetch and display pipeline end-to-end).

title: Verify API failure with cache fallback
description: Run CLI with network down and cached poem available. Verify: FetchError is caught, cache is loaded, poem is displayed with warning message to stderr, exit code is 0.
done_when: TEST-026 passes (API failure with cache fallback shows warning).

title: Verify API failure with empty cache shows honest error
description: Run CLI with network down and no cached poems (first run scenario). Verify: FetchError is caught, cache is empty, fallback message is displayed to stderr, exit code is 1.
done_when: TEST-028 passes (API failure with empty cache shows fallback message and exits 1).

title: Verify config error recovery with defaults
description: Run CLI with malformed config file. Verify: ConfigError is caught, default DisplayConfig is used, poem is displayed with warning message 'Configuration error. Using default display format.', exit code is 0.
done_when: TEST-030 passes (config error triggers default fallback).

title: Verify permission denied handling for cache write
description: Manually test: create ~/.cache/poem/ with read-only permissions (555). Run CLI with API success. Verify: error message about cache write permission is printed to stderr; poem is still displayed (from API); tool continues running; exit code reflects successful display (not crash).
done_when: TEST-014 passes (cache write permission denied doesn't crash tool).

title: Verify timeout enforcement (5 seconds max)
description: Test API Fetcher with a hanging endpoint. Measure time to FetchError. Verify: error is raised within 6 seconds (5-second timeout + 1-second buffer); error message indicates timeout.
done_when: TEST-004 passes (API timeout enforced at 5 seconds).

title: Verify atomic write protection under simulated concurrent access
description: Test Cache Manager atomic write: patch the write function to raise an exception partway through. Verify: final cache file is intact (either previous poem or fully new poem, never corrupted partial write).
done_when: TEST-009 passes (atomic write survives interrupt).

title: Verify tool never crashes on unexpected exception
description: Inject an unexpected exception (e.g., RuntimeError) in a component. Run CLI. Verify: safe error message appears (no traceback), exit code is 1, tool terminates cleanly.
done_when: TEST-033 passes (unexpected exception caught and handled safely).

title: Verify tool works from any directory
description: Run CLI from /tmp, /home, and root directory. Verify: cache and config are always read/written to ~/.cache/poem/ and ~/.config/poem/ (absolute paths), regardless of CWD.
done_when: TEST-036, TEST-037 pass (absolute paths independent of CWD; $HOME respected).

title: Run full test suite and verify no crashes
description: Execute all 54 test specifications (40 acceptance + 7 integration + 7 invariant). Collect results. Verify: all tests pass or are expected to fail with clear reason.
done_when: All 54 tests pass. Coverage matrix shows zero gaps.
